tools.name: search_public_laws
tools.description: Search enacted public laws in the existing five-year feed. Return dated coverage and live/snapshot status; newer or unresolved laws may be missing.

tools.name: read_public_implementation
tools.description: Read existing public source candidates, stages, requirements and coverage for a law and jurisdiction. Candidate matches are not verified law-to-award mappings, physical outcomes or fraud determinations. No private reviews or AI generation.

tools.name: read_research_scope
tools.description: Read supported jurisdictions, programs and evidence limits without accessing private review records.
